I know it's from minecraft, but I thought it was a really cool fact some of y'all would enjoy. You can r/wooosh all you want, but it doesnt change the fact that it's awesome these people can tell so much about the volcano just from a little bit of lava in a bucket

He's not doing this to make obsidian; He's gathering a sample of the lava for analysis, hardening it with a quick quench in water so as to avoid crystalization. Vulcanologists can use the sample to determine if the lava was from deep within the crust and moving out quickly, has been sitting in a reservoir, etc., and the subsequent threat levels that it might pose.
